import csv
import sys

def main():
    groups = {}
    order = []
    with open("дані/контакти.csv", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        next(reader, None)
        for row in reader:
            if not row or all(not c.strip() for c in row):
                continue
            name = row[0] if len(row) > 0 else ""
            email = (row[1] if len(row) > 1 else "").strip().lower()
            if email not in groups:
                groups[email] = []
                order.append(email)
            groups[email].append(name)

    out = []
    for email in order:
        names = groups[email]
        if len(names) >= 2:
            out.append(f"{email}: {len(names)}")
            for n in names:
                out.append(f"  {n}")
    out.append(f"Унікальних: {len(order)}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")

main()
